question: Direction v57 orders this lane to publish the accepted frontier-query-concept-recall numbers BESIDE its own, never in place of them, with any divergence named as the headline. The 39180276526 handoff (accepted 39183749963) compared the A0 baseline cells and COPIED the OUTCOME_B bounded-cause fields verbatim (copy_only_note); the frontier's own audit of 39181670816 re-derived only the latency aggregates from the cache envelopes and re-read the team's records for the rest. The load-bearing negative of the closed recall charter - 'the candidate-only channel recovered 0 of 9 missing frozen authority ids' - has therefore never been re-derived from primary evidence (the 15 committed cache response bodies intersected with the re-hashed frozen authority id sets) by a party outside the frontier team. Does every numeric claim inside the accepted verdict's bounded_cause, latency_budget_breach_named and mechanism-witness evidence reproduce exactly by independent, mapping-free re-derivation from the committed cache envelopes, the re-hashed frozen retrieval spec and this lane's accepted durability record?
product_decision_unlocked: whether the control plane's next recall step (if any) may rely on the accepted bounded cause - that the term-only expansion channel recovered nothing and breached the per-search budget - as independently verified primary-evidence fact, or must first repair the claim; and whether the FR/IT authority-recall gap now has three independent layers of evidence (this lane's durability re-draws, the frontier's A0 reproduction, and this cache-body re-derivation of A1 zero-recovery) or a named divergence between them.

C1_candidate_only_recovery.rule: for each (slug in {corporate-criminal-liability, business-judgment-rule, petty-theft-dismissal} x lang in {de, fr, it}) [rent-default excluded: frozen authority_ids empty => unmeasurable]: re-derive from the matched A1 cache envelope body the set of result canonical_decision_ids; recovered_cell = (body_ids INTERSECT frozen_required_ids) SET-DIFFERENCE frontier_A0_hits; recovered_distinct = UNION over all 9 cells of recovered_cell; missing_distinct = UNION over all 9 cells of (frozen_required_ids SET-DIFFERENCE A0_hits). Expected per the accepted verdict: recovered_distinct is EMPTY (the '0 of 9' claim) and missing_distinct has size 9.

C2_per_cell_record_vs_cache.rule: for each of the 12 frozen-leg cells and the 3 served questions (15 total): the cache envelope whose URL equals 'https://mcp.opencaselaw.ch/api/decisions?query=' + expansion_query with spaces replaced by '+' + '&limit=50&offset=0&sort=relevance&fields=full&include_pinpoint=false' must yield, when its body JSON is parsed, results-length, HTTP status and latency_seconds EXACTLY equal to the harness-recorded A1_candidate_only.n_rows / search.status / search.latency_seconds (leg cells) or A1_candidate.n_rows (served cells, status/latency compared against the latency_budget.per_search_calls entry matched by query). Any mismatch cell is a divergence. Each expansion_query must map to exactly one envelope and every envelope must be claimed by exactly one cell (set relation both directions).

C3_named_responses.rule: re-derived from cache bodies: de-kapitalverletzung expansion => status 200 and 0 rows; fr-bail-entretien expansion => 1 row; corporate-criminal-liability::fr expansion => status 200 and 0 rows - the three responses named verbatim in the accepted bounded_cause prose.

C4_latency_aggregates.rule: re-derived from the 15 envelopes' latency_seconds: n_over_30 (count of values >= 30.0) must equal 10; max must equal 83.5047721599999 exactly (the stored float) and its 1-decimal rounding must equal the prose 83.5; sum compared at 3-decimal rounding against BOTH published values - harness latency_budget.original_live_calls_sum_latency_seconds (600.569) and the audit-of-record recomputation (600.568) - with any disagreement named as a rounding-level divergence cell, never smoothed.

C5_mechanism_witness_count.rule: record-internal cross-check, disclosed as such (union counts are not re-derivable from the frontier cache alone because A0 rows live in the product cache): leg cells use harness A1_union.n_rows vs A0_baseline_shipped.n_rows; served cells use harness A1_candidate.n_rows vs A0_baseline_shipped.n_rows; the count of cells where these differ must equal the verdict evidence field mechanism_witness_cells_with_added_rows (12) out of 15. Additionally the A1_candidate_only.n_rows recorded per leg cell must equal the re-derived body length (already covered by C2).

C6_fr_it_side_by_side.rule: for each of the six failing FR/IT lang-recall cells: publish side by side (a) this lane's accepted durability record accepted_status and live_status (both must read FAIL), (b) the frontier A0 hits (must be empty), (c) the frontier A1_candidate_only newly_found_ids (must be empty), (d) the re-derived recovered_cell from C1 (must be empty). Any column that reads non-empty/changed is a divergence headline.

success_rule.exit_0: CAUSE_REPRODUCED - every pinned digest matches, the audit gate is PASS/safe_to_integrate, and every frozen cell in C1-C6 matches its expectation
success_rule.exit_1: DIVERGENCE_HEADLINE - every pinned digest matches and the audit gate is PASS, but at least one frozen cell diverges; each divergence is the headline of the record and the report, never smoothed or explained away
success_rule.exit_2: ENVIRONMENT - a pinned input is missing or its digest drifts (including the cache manifest), or the audit gate is absent/not PASS; no cell is read
success_rule.no_weakening: no cell, digest, comparison rule, rounding rule or exit mapping may be edited after this file is committed; a moved input is exit 2, never a silent re-pin; a negative result is a result and the instrument exits 0 on it under its own verdict vocabulary
